text:
Olivia: FYI support ticket from AcmeCorp — their v1 SDKs started getting handled by v2 paths and they saw double billing. They pasted a request sample.
Sanjay: Does this align with the implicit fallback we enabled in the router last month? If so we need better visibility.
Marie: Paste the sample header and request id please.
Olivia: Sample header: ```x-redwood-client-version: 1.2.3
x-redwood-route-prefer: v2-fallback
User-Agent: AcmeSDK/1.2.3 (iOS)```
Olivia: Their SDK sometimes strips version headers, so fallback triggered.
Taylor: Console UX idea: banner that clearly says "Compatibility fallback active — update SDK" with a link and an action to pin strict routing per-route.
Sanjay: Telemetry: we must emit an event whenever the routing layer applies a compatibility fallback. Suggest metric `compat.fallback.applied` (counter) with tags tenant_id, route, fallback_reason.
Olivia: Also the quota attribution is confusing: fallback traffic is currently counted against the v2 quota, so tenants get unexpected usage. Support is escalating.
Marie: UI can show a "compat impact" card with 30d token delta estimate and affected token count. That helps support and product.
Sanjay: Backend constraints: we cannot rewrite past billing. Forward plan: attach an attribution label on requests and optionally remap to the v1 quota bucket for future requests when tenant opts in. Header we can add in responses: `x-redwood-compat-attrib: v1-mapped`.
Olivia: Audit trail request: low-sampled audit logs `compat.mapping.decisions` containing tenant, token, and decision. Keep sampling to avoid log explosion.
Sanjay: Implementation sketch: 1) Emit `compat.fallback.applied` for every fallback. 2) Add `compat.quota_remap.tokens` metric when remapping. 3) Emit sampled `compat.mapping.decisions`. 4) Add response header `x-redwood-compat-attrib` when we remap. 5) Expose per-tenant panel in Console.
Taylor: Product asks for a beta: per-route strict/pin setting + banner within 2w for Sales to promise to customers. Metering changes can take 4-6w.
Sanjay: 2w for banner/pin behind a feature flag seems doable. Full metering shims need careful rollout and observability; estimate 4-6 weeks.
Marie: I'll mock banner copy & the impact card and post in #product by EOD. Need metric names and field details from infra.
Sanjay: Metric names: `compat.fallback.applied` (counter), `compat.quota_remap.tokens` (sum), tag `affected_tokens_count`, and `compat.mapping.decisions.v1` as sampled audit stream.
Olivia: Support asks to expose unique tokens affected per tenant in the panel. Important for billing conversations.
Taylor: Order of ops proposal: 1) telemetry + canary shim 2) Console banner + pinning flag 3) opt-in quota remap 4) phased auto-migration if opt-in absent. Agree?
All: LGTM :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy: canary-compat-shim v0.1 rolled to us-east-1 canaries at 1744445580 :white_check_mark:
Sanjay: I'll open the PR and link the canary id so Support can reconcile tickets.
Olivia: Thanks — Support will draft KB and include steps to pin strict routing for customers.
